column1: # Turkish search benchmark (2026-09-17). One query per line: <query> TAB <relevance key>.
# A result is RELEVANT when every key token matches a word of its names or brand, after the same
# folding the app uses (case, accents and the dotless ı folded away). A plain token matches as a
# word prefix, so `fistik` covers `fıstıklı`. A token starting with `=` must equal a whole word, and
# `/` separates accepted spellings: `=sut/sutu` accepts `süt` and `sütü` but not `sütlü` (milk
# chocolate), and `=bal/bali/balli` keeps `balık` (fish) out of a honey query.
# A result is OBVIOUS LEAKAGE when it matches none of the key tokens at all.
# Accented and ASCII spellings of the same query sit next to each other on purpose: the live
# service does not fold Turkish letters, so the two can return different pages.
